name.description: The logical name of this instance of Orthanc.

storage_directory.description: Path to the directory that holds the heavyweight files (i.e. the raw DICOM instances).

index_directory.description: Path to the directory that holds the SQLite index.

storage_compression.description: Enable the transparent compression of the DICOM instances.

maximum_storage_size.description: Maximum size of the storage in MB (a value of "0" indicates no limit on the storage size).

maximum_patient_count.description: Maximum number of patients that can be stored at a given time in the storage.

maximum_storage_mode.description: Action to take when the maximum storage is reached.

maximum_storage_cache_size.description: Maximum size of the storage cache in MB.

lua_heartbeat_period.description: The period (in seconds) between 2 calls of the "OnHeartBeat" lua callback.

plugins_path.description: Path to the directory of plugins to be loaded.

concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum number of processing jobs that are simultaneously running at any given time.

jobs_engine_threads_count_resource_modif.description: Number of threads used to execute ResourceModification jobs.

orthanc_explorer_enabled.description: Enable/disable the Orthanc Explorer Web user interface.

http_port.description: HTTP port for the REST services and for the GUI.

http_describe_errors.description: Enable/disable JSON error messages in HTTP answers.

webdav_enabled.description: Enable the publication of the content of the Orthanc server as a WebDAV share.

webdav_delete_allowed.description: Whether to allow deletions through the WebDAV share.

webdav_upload_allowed.description: Whether to allow uploads through the WebDAV share.

dicom_check_called_aet.description: Check whether the called AET corresponds to the AET of Orthanc.

default_encoding.description: The default encoding assumed for DICOM files without SpecificCharacterSet DICOM tag.

accepted_transfer_syntaxes.description: The transfer syntaxes that are accepted by Orthanc C-STORE SCP (wildcards allowed).

unknown_sop_class_accepted.description: Whether Orthanc accepts to act as C-STORE SCP for unknown storage SOP classes.

dicom_scp_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which DICOM associations are closed by the Orthanc SCP.

remote_access_allowed.description: Whether remote hosts can connect to the HTTP server.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether or not SSL is enabled.

ssl_certificate.description: Path to the SSL certificate used by the HTTP server.

ssl_minimum_protocol_version.description: Sets the minimum accepted SSL protocol version for the HTTP server.

ssl_verify_peers.description: Whether or not peer client certificates shall be checked.

ssl_trusted_client_certificates.description: Path to a file containing the concatenation of the client SSL certificate(s).

dicom_tls_enabled.description: Whether DICOM TLS is enabled in the Orthanc SCP.

dicom_tls_remote_certificate_required.description: Whether Orthanc rejects DICOM TLS connections from modalities that do not provide a certificate.

dicom_tls_minimum_protocol_version.description: Sets the minimum accepted TLS protocol version for the DICOM server.

dicom_always_allow_echo.description: Whether the Orthanc SCP allows incoming C-ECHO requests from unknown modalities.

dicom_always_allow_store.description: Whether the Orthanc SCP allows incoming C-STORE requests from unknown modalities.

dicom_always_allow_find.description: Whether the Orthanc SCP allows incoming C-FIND requests from unknown modalities.

dicom_always_allow_find_worklist.description: Whether the Orthanc SCP allows incoming C-FIND requests for worklists from unknown modalities.

dicom_always_allow_get.description: Whether the Orthanc SCP allows incoming C-GET requests from unknown modalities.

dicom_always_allow_move.description: Whether the Orthanc SCP allows incoming C-MOVE requests from unknown modalities.

dicom_check_modality_host.description: Whether Orthanc checks the IP/hostname address of the remote modality.

dicom_modalities_in_database.description: Whether to store the DICOM modalities in the Orthanc database instead of in this configuration file.

dicom_echo_checks_find.description: Whether the C-ECHO SCU is automatically followed by a C-FIND SCU.

dicom_default_retrieve_method.description: Whether Orthanc uses C-MOVE or C-GET to retrieve a resource after a C-Find.

dicom_scu_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which DICOM associations are considered closed by the Orthanc SCU.

dicom_scu_preferred_transfer_syntax.description: Preferred transfer syntax to transcode an instance if the remote modality doesn't support the original syntax.

dicom_threads_count.description: Number of threads that are used by the embedded DICOM server.

orthanc_peers_in_database.description: Whether to store the Orthanc peers in the Orthanc database instead of in this configuration file.

http_proxy.description: Parameters of the HTTP proxy to be used by Orthanc.

http_verbose.description: If set to "true", debug messages from libcurl will be issued.

http_timeout.description: Set the timeout for HTTP requests issued by Orthanc (in seconds).

https_verify_peers.description: Enable the verification of the peers certificates during HTTPS requests.

https_ca_certificates.description: Path to the CA certificates to validate peers in HTTPS requests.

stable_age.description: Number of seconds without receiving any instance before a patient, a study or a series is considered as stable.

store_md5_for_attachments.description: Compute and store the MD5 of the DICOM files.

limit_find_results.description: Maximum number of results for a single C-FIND request at the Patient, Study or Series level.

limit_find_instances.description: Maximum number of results for a single C-FIND request at the Instance level.

log_exported_resources.description: Log the resources that are exported to other DICOM modalities or Orthanc peers.

keep_alive_timeout.description: Defines the Keep-Alive timeout in seconds.

http_threads_count.description: Number of threads that are used by the embedded HTTP server.

store_dicom.description: If set to "false", Orthanc will run in index-only mode.

dicom_association_close_delay.description: Number of seconds of inactivity to wait before automatically closing a DICOM association used by Lua.

query_retrieve_size.description: Maximum number of query/retrieve DICOM requests that are maintained by Orthanc.

case_sensitive_pn.description: Enable case-sensitive match for PN value representation.

load_private_dictionary.description: If set to "false", Orthanc will not load its default dictionary of private tags.

synchronous_c_move.description: Whether to run DICOM C-MOVE operations synchronously.

jobs_history_size.description: Maximum number of completed jobs that are kept in memory.

save_jobs.description: Whether to save the jobs into the Orthanc database.

overwrite_instances.description: Specifies how Orthanc reacts when it receives a DICOM instance whose SOPInstanceUID is already stored.

media_archive_size.description: Maximum number of ZIP/media archives that are maintained by Orthanc.

storage_access_on_find.description: Performance setting to specify how Orthanc accesses the storage area during find operations.

execute_lua_enabled.description: Whether calls to URI "/tools/execute-script" is enabled.

rest_api_write_to_file_system_enabled.description: Whether the REST API can write to the filesystem.

http_request_timeout.description: Set the timeout while serving HTTP requests by the embedded Web server, in seconds.

default_private_creator.description: Set the default private creator that is used by Orthanc when it looks for a private tag.

storage_commitment_reports_size.description: Maximum number of storage commitment reports to be kept in memory.

transcode_dicom_protocol.description: Whether Orthanc transcodes DICOM files to an uncompressed transfer syntax over the DICOM protocol.

builtin_decoder_transcoder_order.description: Specifies whether the built-in decoder/transcoder of Orthanc is applied before or after the plugins.

ingest_transcoding_of_uncompressed.description: Whether ingest transcoding is applied to incoming DICOM instances that have an uncompressed transfer syntax.

ingest_transcoding_of_compressed.description: Whether ingest transcoding is applied to incoming DICOM instances that have a compressed transfer syntax.

dicom_lossy_transcoding_quality.description: The default compression level that is used when transcoding to one of the lossy/JPEG transfer syntaxes.

sync_storage_area.description: Whether "fsync()" is called after each write to the storage area.

deidentify_logs.description: Deidentify/anonymize the contents of the logs.

deidentify_logs_dicom_version.description: The DICOM standard to follow for the deidentification/anonymization of the query contents.

maximum_pdu_length.description: Maximum length of the PDU (Protocol Data Unit) in the DICOM network protocol, expressed in bytes.

check_revisions.description: Whether Orthanc protects the modification of metadata and attachments using revisions.

synchronous_zip_stream.description: Whether Orthanc streams ZIP archive/media to the HTTP client.

zip_loader_threads.description: Default number of loader threads when generating Zip archive/media.

read_only.description: Configure Orthanc in read only mode.

maximum_concurrent_dcmtk_transcoders.description: Maximum number of DCMTK transcoders that are simultaneously running at any given time.
